items.exampleEn: The book was written in collaboration with a famous chef.
items.exampleZh: 這本書是和一位知名主廚合作寫成的。

items.exampleEn: The new phone got a strong endorsement from many experts.
items.exampleZh: 這支新手機獲得許多專家的大力推薦。

items.exampleEn: She often collaborates with artists from other countries.
items.exampleZh: 她經常和其他國家的藝術家合作。

items.exampleEn: Writing a dictionary is a collaborative effort.
items.exampleZh: 編寫字典是一項需要合作的工作。

items.exampleEn: A plaque on the wall shows when the hotel opened.
items.exampleZh: 牆上的一塊牌匾標示著這家飯店開業的時間。

items.exampleEn: Let's swap seats so you can sit by the window.
items.exampleZh: 我們換個座位吧，這樣你就能坐窗邊。

items.sentenceEn: The design team works in a collaborative way.
items.sentenceZh: 設計團隊以互相合作的方式工作。

items.audioEn: The company gave him a silver plaque for thirty years of service.
items.audioZh: 公司頒給他一塊銀牌匾，表揚他服務了三十年。
options: For finding a new way to save money

items.sentenceEn: The two cities swapped ideas about public transport.
items.sentenceZh: 兩座城市交流了大眾運輸方面的點子。

items.sentenceEn: The plan has the endorsement of every teacher.
items.sentenceZh: 這個計畫得到每一位老師的支持。

items.stemEn: The film is a ____ between two young directors.
items.stemZh: 這部電影是兩位年輕導演合作的作品。

items.stemEn: Can we ____ shifts this weekend? I have a wedding to go to.
items.stemZh: 這個週末我們可以換班嗎？我要去參加一場婚禮。

items.passageEn: Last spring, a bakery and a bookshop on the same street decided to collaborate. The idea was simple: customers who bought a book could swap their receipt for a free coffee next door, and the bakery displayed new books on its shelves. The collaboration was so popular that the local business association gave both shops an endorsement in its monthly magazine. At the end of the year, the two owners received a plaque from the town for their collaborative spirit. They now plan to invite a third shop to join.
items.passageZh: 去年春天，同一條街上的一家麵包店和一家書店決定合作。點子很簡單：在書店買書的顧客，可以用收據到隔壁換一杯免費咖啡；麵包店也在架上陳列新書。這項合作大受歡迎，當地商業協會還在月刊上為兩家店背書推薦。年底時，兩位老闆因為合作精神，獲得鎮上頒發的紀念牌匾。現在他們打算邀請第三家店加入。

questions.questionZh: 買書的顧客可以得到什麼？
年底時兩位老闆得到了什麼？
options: 商業協會頒發的一大筆獎金
一篇介紹他們的報紙專題報導

items.promptZh: 這兩位歌手打算明年一起合作一張專輯。
referenceEn: The two singers plan to collaborate on an album next year.
The two singers are going to collaborate on a new album next year.
rubricZh: collaborate 表示「合作」，用法例如 collaborate on an album、collaborate with someone 等
「打算」可寫，例如 plan to、are going to 等
「一張專輯」可寫，例如 an album、a record 等

items.instructionZh: 用 swap 造一個句子，說說你曾經和別人交換過的東西。
referenceEn: I swapped my sandwich for my friend's apple at lunch.
My sister and I often swap clothes.
rubricZh: swap 當動詞表示「交換」，用法例如 swap A for B、swap clothes 等
句子要說到你自己的經驗

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：干擾項 cloak／hedgehog／somersault 與「電影是兩位導演之間的___」語意完全無關，一眼即可排除（§11-26）；作者疑慮成立：這題本應靠詞義判斷，卻沒有鑑別力。建議改用與合作／電影情境相近、但代入後明顯不通的已學名詞，換後重新代入確認單一解。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 干擾項換成同屬作品／媒體情境的已教名詞 depiction、portrayal、coverage（u21），只看英文時代入 a ____ between two young directors 都不通
